subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact ask, example files, and delivery options
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Doucet <claire@NimbusHealth.com>
Cc: audit@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-06-02T09:14:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact ask, example files, and delivery options

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the call earlier — excited to support Nimbus Health as you onboard Redwood. To get the SOC 2 Type II package moving, can you confirm the audit window you want covered (e.g., 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30 or similar)? That helps us choose the right evidence slices.

Below is a short, minimal list of artifacts we typically provide for initial review and what we recommend sharing up-front:

- Short report: SOC2-Summary-Short.pdf (one-page controls overview + statement of coverage)
- Configuration snapshots: sample-configs.tar.gz (sanitized examples of IaC + prod config)
- Telemetry samples: pv-telemetry-sample.csv (1–3 days of anonymized token/latency telemetry)
- Bridge letter: bridge-letter-template.docx (if audit window ends prior to report date)

Transfer options we accept: secure SFTP, AWS S3 presigned link, or encrypted Drive share. If you prefer, we can provide a temporary SFTP account and an upload manifest.

If you can confirm the audit window and whether a bridge letter is needed, I’ll assemble a minimal bundle and a short mutual action plan with dates for ingestion, reviewer Q&A, and final delivery.

Quick one-line asks you can forward to your security lead: 1) Confirm audit window, 2) Share a sanitized sample of infra configs and one telemetry CSV, 3) Indicate if bridge letter required.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: (none yet)
From: Claire Doucet <claire@NimbusHealth.com>

Date: 2026-06-02T13:02:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact ask, example files, and delivery options

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate the clear list. Audit window: we want coverage for 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30.

A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- For the telemetry sample, would a single 24-hour slice from production be acceptable (we’ll anonymize user IDs)?
- On configs — we can provide sanitized Terraform + one Chef/Puppet manifest. Are those formats okay?
- Bridge letter: likely yes, since our audit report is still in progress. Can you send your standard template?

I’ll loop in our security operator if we need to create an upload account or share via S3. Attaching our internal inventory.csv to show the systems we’ll include (attachment: inventory.csv (csv)).

Thanks,
Claire
Director, Information Security
Nimbus Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Doucet <claire@NimbusHealth.com>
Cc: audit@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-06-03T16:40:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial artifact bundle and secure upload details

Hi Claire,

Thanks — attached is our minimal initial bundle you can use as examples and the bridge letter template. Per the plan below, we’ve prepared the files described earlier.

Attachments (stubs):
- SOC2-Summary-Short.pdf (PDF, 1 page) — short control coverage + retention note
- bridge-letter-template.docx (DOCX) — customizable bridge letter covering audit window to report issuance
- sample-configs.tar.gz (tar.gz) — contains sanitized Terraform main.tf and one service manifest (README included)
- pv-telemetry-sample.csv (CSV) — 24-hour anonymized token/latency telemetry example

Upload options: we created a temporary SFTP user (nimbus-upload-2026) valid for 7 days. SFTP details (separate secure message) or if you prefer, send an S3 presigned link and we’ll download immediately.

Next suggested steps:
1) You upload sanitized artifacts to SFTP by 2026-06-07.
2) We schedule a 30-minute reviewer Q&A on 2026-06-09 — propose 15:00 US/Pacific.
3) If the auditor requires a bridge letter, the attached DOCX is editable; we can return a signed PDF once finalized.

If you need us to accept a different file format or have constraints about telemetry fields, let me know and we’ll adapt.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
